settingsUi.reason: Model tiers retain summary cards and an explicit editor with Save and Cancel. A media function uses compact source/model rows whenever any mode has multiple models, including when the selected mode has only one. Other functions whose modes all have one or no concrete model use a single dropdown without model text below. Music always retains Source and Model rows; a single music model displays a disabled service default label while preserving its effective identity. Multiple music models retain their concrete choices. Advisor uses the same compact rows without repeating the selected model on the left. Image generation and editing share the same model selection; no separate editing-model row is shown. Source changes use the exact remembered model immediately. Pending saves preserve usable controls across remounts, and rapid choices save in order. Image, video, speech and music defaults share one multimodal section with two columns in reading order and one column at narrow content widths. Subscription credentials are configured once in the shared source tabs without a language heading or repeated modality account sections. Custom media endpoints remain editable only in the custom source tab.
